title: 存在 ≠ 启用 ≠ 被消费
body: 检查源码能力、发布配置、状态寿命和下游消费者。关闭一个命名模块不等于移除了所有历史通道。
title_zh: 存在 ≠ 启用 ≠ 被消费
body_zh: 检查源码能力、发布配置、状态寿命和下游消费者。关闭一个命名模块不等于移除了所有历史通道。
title_en: Available is not enabled; enabled is not consumed.
body_en: Inspect source capability, release configuration, state lifetime and the downstream consumer. Disabling one named module does not remove every historical channel.

title: 观测证据与预测计划
body: WorldLA、RAP 的旧计划延续保存的是尚未执行的意图。评测要分开测量动作连续性和早期事实保留。
body_zh: WorldLA、RAP 的旧计划延续保存的是尚未执行的意图。评测要分开测量动作连续性和早期事实保留。
title_en: Evidence and intended action have different lifetimes.
body_en: WorldLA and RAP retain unexecuted intentions through plan continuation. Evaluate action continuity separately from retention of early observed facts.

title: 跨策略交接的状态缺口
body: GO-3 的程序知道阶段和失败历史，但这些信息没有自动进入 WAM。应对照当前输入、原始日志、类型化状态三种交接。
title_zh: 跨策略交接的状态缺口
body_zh: GO-3 的程序知道阶段和失败历史，但这些信息没有自动进入 WAM。应对照当前输入、原始日志、类型化状态三种交接。
title_en: Memory can disappear at a policy handoff.
body_en: GO-3 program state contains phase and failure history, but these do not automatically enter the WAM. Compare current-input-only, raw-log and typed-state handoffs.

title: 记忆的存活时间需要测量
body: G07 的峰值缓存容量不等于重置后的可用历史；HWM 的追加字符串不等于已撤销过期事实。
title_zh: 记忆的存活时间需要测量
body_zh: G07 的峰值缓存容量不等于重置后的可用历史；HWM 的追加字符串不等于已撤销过期事实。
title_en: Measure how long a memory survives.
body_en: G07 peak cache capacity does not describe available history after a reset. HWM append-only strings do not by themselves revoke outdated facts.

title: 开发经验也有来源
body: PyRUA-RSI 与 HexaShell 将开发经验固化为程序和笔记。无梯度更新不等于无经验；冻结不自动保证独立评测。
body_zh: PyRUA-RSI 与 HexaShell 将开发经验固化为程序和笔记。无梯度更新不等于无经验；冻结不自动保证独立评测。
body_en: PyRUA-RSI and HexaShell consolidate development experience into programs and notes. No gradient update does not mean no experience, and freezing alone does not establish independent evaluation.

title: 时间索引是输入语义
body: 用原生控制步、相机和真实执行回执解释采样间隔。可配置偏移与文字时间标签需要联合核验。
body_zh: 用原生控制步、相机和真实执行回执解释采样间隔。可配置偏移与文字时间标签需要联合核验。
title_en: A time index is part of the evidence.
body_en: Interpret sampling intervals using native control steps, cameras and actual execution receipts. Configurable offsets and textual time labels need to be checked together.

title_en: A write should mean something happened.
title_zh: 写入应对应真实发生的事
body_en: AGM and EventSync connect progress writes to completion evidence; REMM introduces retractable dependency-aware memory. A useful comparison holds capacity fixed and tests incorrect completion writes, stale facts and recovery cost.
body_zh: AGM 与 EventSync 将进度写入连接到完成证据；REMM 引入可撤回的依赖记忆。值得在相同容量下比较错误完成写入、过期事实和纠错成本。

title_en: Memory belongs at more than one timescale.
title_zh: 记忆需要落在不同时间尺度
body_en: Ledger separates policy perception from an external object-event ledger; HiMe separates execution, monitoring and planning rates. Compare where evidence lives and how it crosses interfaces, as well as the number of tokens retained.
body_zh: Ledger 将策略感知与外部对象事件账本分开；HiMe 区分执行、监测和规划频率。除了 token 数量，还应比较证据保存在哪里，以及如何跨接口传递。

title_zh: 先判断失败原因，再固化经验
body_en: EmbodiSkill, EnactOpt and AdaRSI motivate different update targets: skill content, context construction, scheduling or executor capability. A failed attempt should not automatically become a permanent rule; test attribution before measuring accumulated memory.
body_zh: EmbodiSkill、EnactOpt 与 AdaRSI 提示不同更新对象：技能内容、上下文构造、调度或执行器能力。一次失败不宜自动变成永久规则，应先检验归因，再衡量经验积累。

title: Separate memory content, encoding and consumer.
title_en: Separate memory content, encoding and consumer.
title_zh: 分开描述记忆内容、编码方式与读取者。
body: A sampled window, a pooled token grid, and a planner summary describe different design axes. Multiple modalities or scales can coexist within one domain-method home.
body_en: A sampled window, a pooled token grid, and a planner summary describe different design axes. Multiple modalities or scales can coexist within one domain-method home.
body_zh: 采样窗口、池化 token 网格和规划摘要属于不同设计轴；多模态与多尺度可以共存于同一个领域与方法归属中。

title: A subtask label is not proof of completion.
title_en: A subtask label is not proof of completion.
title_zh: 子任务标签不等于已完成事实。
body: Liber-0 Preview records prior subtask instructions on transitions. Separate intended steps, observed outcomes and corrected facts when designing planner-to-policy memory.
body_en: Liber-0 Preview records prior subtask instructions on transitions. Separate intended steps, observed outcomes and corrected facts when designing planner-to-policy memory.
body_zh: Liber-0 Preview 在切换时记录过去子任务指令；设计规划器到策略的记忆时，应分开计划步骤、真实结果与更正事实。

title: Compare memory under matched budgets.
title_zh: 在相同预算下比较记忆。
body: WorldBridge provides sequential memory ablations; Long-WAM links context benefits to pretraining. Different leaderboard totals do not isolate the effect of memory.
body_en: WorldBridge provides sequential memory ablations; Long-WAM links context benefits to pretraining. Different leaderboard totals do not isolate the effect of memory.
body_zh: WorldBridge 提供逐项加入记忆的消融，Long-WAM 将上下文收益与预训练关联；不同榜单总分不能隔离记忆的贡献。
